purpose: Teach: 美学/うかがい/異物/恥ずかしながら/相まって/のけ/汚し/勝た

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、研究には美学を持って臨め
lines.en: Ren — bring aesthetic rigor to your research.
lines.style: Measured, professorial. Opens with the name like drawing attention. Deliberate pause. Light emphasis on 「美学」 — this matters. Calm authority, not lecturing. The weight of standards held steady.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。教授のご意見、うかがい、論文に反映します
lines.en: Yes. I'll take your insights to heart and incorporate them into the paper.
lines.style: Respectful but genuine. Slightly hesitant at the start — gathering himself. Steady commitment underneath. Not performative deference, but sincere acknowledgment of guidance received.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、実験で異物混入は絶対避けろ
lines.en: Ren — in the lab, contamination is non-negotiable. Avoid it at all costs.
lines.style: Direct and firm. The name lands cleanly. Slight lean forward. No room for error in the tone. Clear expectation, but not unkind — this is boundary-setting from someone who knows what matters.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 恥ずかしながら、先週の実験、失敗しました
lines.en: I'm afraid I failed in last week's experiment.
lines.style: Quiet self-reproach. The embarrassment is real but contained. Speaks carefully, as if owning the failure fully. A pause before he delivers it — he's already turned it over in his mind many times.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、努力と運が相まっての論文発表だ
lines.en: Research succeeds when effort and fortune meet, Ren. Remember that.
lines.style: Reflective, almost philosophical. Slower pace. Gentle authority — this is wisdom, not criticism. A brief pause mid-thought, like he's choosing the words carefully. Warm beneath the surface.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究室メンバーをのけ者にしない配慮をしております
lines.en: Yes. I make sure no one on the team feels left behind in this work.
lines.style: Earnest conviction. Slight emphasis on 「メンバーを」 — people matter to him. Thoughtful, not rushed. The sincerity is straightforward, without need to prove it.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、論文の信頼を汚しかねない引用を避けろ
lines.en: Ren — protect the paper's credibility. Question every citation you use.
lines.style: Firm but not harsh. The name opens it. A beat of emphasis on 「信頼を」 — trust is fragile. Steady eye contact in the voice. This is non-negotiable but spoken from care.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。先行研究に勝たねば博士は取れません
lines.en: Yes. I can't earn my doctorate without standing on honest ground.
lines.style: Quietly determined. The gravity of it sits underneath every word. No bravado — just a steady understanding of what's required. Slight trailing commitment at the end.
